title: LinkDef
description: design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (LinkDef object): describes support for a native scene/link record between a controller and responder node, scoped to a plugin and/or product family (e.g. Insteon, Z-Wave). Authored fresh -- no equivalent file exists anywhere in iox-vscode-plugin's schemas/ (that dialect has no `linkdefs` concept at all; its root plugin.schema.json has no `linkdefs` key). Referenced from nodedef.schema.json's `links.ctl`/`links.rsp` arrays. Matches src/nucore/linkdef.py's LinkDef/LinkParameter dataclasses, except LinkParameter's `init_val`/`init_uom` fields, which exist on the dataclass but are never populated by src/nucore/profile.py's current parser -- not represented here since they have no documented spec counterpart (see schemas/README.md). `name` is optional here despite no '(Optional)' marker in the spec table -- src/nucore/profile.py reads it via `ldict.get("name")`.

then.$comment: Per the spec: 'If true, any direct command for a responder can be used in the link (default false). The linkdef must not specify any parameters.'

id.description: LinkDef ID used by the NodeDef.

protocol.description: The protocol supported (may contain any alphanumeric text or underscore), e.g. "I_STD", "I_STD_ADV".

cmd.description: If true, any direct command for a responder can be used in the link. The linkdef must not specify any parameters.

format.description: How this command is displayed in the scene, when used as a responder -- see plugin_model.md §4 (Formatting in Programs and Scenes).

parameters.description: Responders only -- the parameters passed when the scene is triggered. Same shape as Cmd parameters, except `init` is not used here.
